full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white street photograph shows a young person looking directly toward the camera from a close crowd, with dark framing and blurred passersby surrounding the face. The background is compressed into soft patches of pale and charcoal gray, interrupted near the top by a bright horizontal opening and darker structural bands. Along the left side, a thick vertical dark frame divides the image; behind it, one face is partly visible at the extreme edge. Another younger face emerges just to its right, slightly behind the central subject, with only part of the head and shoulders clear. In the center, the main young person has short, tousled light hair, a pale face, open eyes, and a serious, slightly uncertain expression. The head is angled a little toward the viewer, while the body turns sideways beneath a heavy dark coat. The collar and shoulders fill much of the lower center, and a narrow lighter fold runs near the neck. The face is sharply enough rendered for the gaze and individual strands of hair to hold attention, yet it remains part of the unstaged flow of people. On the right, a large passerby's dark head and shoulder move close to the lens, becoming a soft foreground veil that hides part of the central subject and most of the background. Additional indistinct figures and dark shapes layer behind the visible faces. The nearest blurred form makes the viewer feel physically inside the crowd rather than looking at a posed group from a distance. Light arrives softly from the open street around the upper left and center, lifting the central face and hair while the coat and the near passerby fall into deep shadow. Fine film grain and the modest softness of the background give the print a tactile, candid surface. Strong blacks in the left frame and right foreground hold the lighter faces between them, creating a narrow channel of attention through the overlapping bodies. There is no readable text in the scene. The overall composition is close, asymmetrical, and immediate, using selective focus and passing obstruction to make an ordinary moment feel intimate and unsettled.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白街头照片呈现拥挤人群中一名直视镜头的年轻人，深色边框与模糊的路人围绕着这张脸。背景被压缩成浅灰与炭灰的柔软色块，上方附近一道明亮的水平开口被较深的结构横带打断。左侧有一道粗厚的深色竖框分隔画面；其后最边缘露出一张被遮住的脸。另一张更年轻的脸出现在竖框右侧、主体的稍后方，只有部分头部和肩膀清晰。中央的主要年轻人有浅色短乱发、白皙的脸、睁开的眼睛和严肃而略带不安的神情。头部微微转向观者，身体则在厚重的深色外套下侧转。衣领和肩膀占据下部中央的大部分位置，颈旁有一道较浅的窄褶。面部足够清晰，让目光和单根发丝成为注意焦点，却仍属于未经安排的人流。右侧，一名路人深色的头和肩膀靠近镜头，化作柔软的前景遮幕，挡住主体的一部分和大部分后景。可见的脸后方还层叠着其他模糊人影与暗形。近处模糊形体让观者仿佛置身人群内部，而非远远观看摆好姿势的一组人。柔和的光从左上和中央的开阔街面进入，提亮中央的脸与头发，而外套和近处路人落入深影。细微胶片颗粒与背景适度的柔化赋予照片可触的抓拍表面。左侧竖框及右侧前景的强黑色把较亮的脸夹在中间，穿过重叠身体形成一条狭窄的注意通道。场景没有可读文字。整体构图贴近、不对称而直接，以选择性清晰和过路遮挡让普通一瞬显得亲密且不安。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white street-photographic treatment joins a clear middle-distance focal area to large, soft foreground obstructions. Human scale feels immediate because the frame crops forms closely and allows overlapping silhouettes to conceal parts of one another. Deep blacks act as irregular side anchors, while a limited run of pale grays leads the eye through a narrow central opening. Diffuse available light brightens selected surfaces without the hard separation of a studio setup, and shadow keeps the surrounding activity dense. Fine film grain and softly resolving background detail give the image the tactile character of an unposed print. Focus shifts by depth rather than by drawn outlines: near and far shapes blur, but a few middle-plane edges and surface details stay legible. The composition relies on interruption, asymmetry, and the chance arrangement of passing forms. The overall effect is intimate, observant, and slightly restless, with visual tension coming from proximity and selective clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白街头摄影表现把清晰的中距离焦点区域与大面积柔化的前景遮挡结合起来。画框贴近地裁切形体，允许重叠剪影互相遮住一部分，因此尺度感直接而迫近。深黑色充当不规则的两侧锚点，有限的浅灰色层次引导视线穿过狭窄的中央开口。漫射的现场光提亮选中的表面，没有影棚布光那种硬性分隔；阴影使周围活动保持密集。细微胶片颗粒与柔和消隐的背景细节赋予画面未经摆拍的冲印质感。清晰度随纵深改变，而不是靠描画轮廓：近处与远处形体模糊，少数中层边缘和表面细节仍可辨认。构图依赖中断、不对称和经过画面的形体偶然形成的排列。整体效果亲近、敏锐且略带躁动，视觉张力来自逼近的距离与有选择的清晰。
theme_en: A young person looking toward the camera amid a crowded street
theme_zh: 拥挤街头一名望向镜头的年轻人
name: David Hurn
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
